get.description: Authorised on every request and streamed by the API: there is no shareable storage URL.

post.description: Reconcile work whose outcome was unknown, after checking the provider's own records.

put.description: Set the limit for the current period. A limit cannot be set below what is already spent or held.

get.description: The live call list for a date in the workspace's time zone.

post.description: The user says what happened. Until this is called, nothing claims the call connected.
Preview with ``dry_run`` (the default), then repeat with ``dry_run: false`` to apply.

get.description: Suggestions only. Nothing is merged without an explicit, reviewed request.

post.description: Merge ``source_id`` into this company. History, restrictions and evidence all move.
Record a request or consent with its scope. A request for one follow-up is not consent to campaigns.
Start a draft for a lead, or a reply in a conversation. Nothing is sent from here.

patch.description: Any change to recipient, subject or text makes a new version and withdraws an earlier approval.

get.description: Conversations for a record, or the review queue of replies that could not be matched to one.

post.description: A person decides which record an unmatched conversation belongs to, or that it belongs to none.
Upload a prospect list. It is parsed in the background into a preview; nothing is imported yet.

put.description: Change which column feeds which field, then rebuild the preview.

patch.description: Decide what happens to one row, for example whether a possible duplicate is imported.

get.description: Public: lets an invited person see what they are accepting. Needs the exact token.
Score history, newest first. Each entry names the rubric version it was computed under.

post.description: A reviewer sets the components. The total and tier are computed here, never supplied.

delete.description: Stop using a mailbox and erase its stored authorisation. Conversations already synchronised are kept.

post.description: Record that a person re-checked a finding today. Only this turns imported research into verified research.
An owner records that the rules were checked against current requirements. Until then unsolicited email is blocked.

get.description: Distinct values for the filter controls.

post.description: Record that the dialler is being opened for a permitted number. This is not a completed call.
Log a call made outside the app, for example from a desk phone. No dialler launch is recorded.

delete.description: Revoke and erase the stored credential. The connection record and its usage history remain.

put.description: Reconnect or rotate. History that refers to this connection is kept.

post.description: Re-encrypt the stored credential with the current key version (used during key rotation).

put.description: Record what kind of recipient an address belongs to, and the evidence. The mail domain is not evidence.

post.description:
Import an opt-out register that was obtained through its official channel: one address per line.

The application does not fetch a register by itself, and never treats a missing one as empty.
A reviewer accepts a candidate. Only then does it become a lead, with its evidence and a proposed score.
Start a run. It needs a budget and two connected providers; it never spends beyond its cost cap.

get.description: Search provenance: what was asked, of whom, when, and what came back.

post.description: Freeze today's (or tomorrow's) list as a dated snapshot. Fewer entries are returned when fewer are eligible.

get.description: A dated snapshot. Each entry shows the score when it was taken and the prospect as it is now.

put.description: Record the outcome of reviewing a source's terms. Storage is only possible once a source is approved.

get.description: This month's usage. Verified and estimated amounts are kept apart: an estimate is not a bill.

put.description: Replace the manual tags on a record. Imported and automated tags are kept.
